backwards: a character range that runs backwards
classAnchor: an anchor or a backreference (`\\{$c}`) cannot stand inside a character class
classBackslash: a backslash at the end of a character class
classRange: a range (`-`) whose end is a shorthand or a class
classUnclosed: a character class with no closing `]`
codepointRange: a code point escape above `10FFFF` or in the surrogates `D800` to `DFFF`
controlLetter: a control escape (`\\c`) with no ASCII letter after it
countBudget: counted repetition that expands the pattern past 16384 terms
countForm: a counted repetition (`\{m,n\}`) whose number a `,` or a `\}` does not follow
countNumber: a counted repetition (`\{m,n\}`) with no number where one is expected
countOrder: a counted repetition whose maximum is below its minimum
countUnclosed: a counted repetition with no closing `\}`
emptyClass: a character class with no members
expected: a pattern is expected to hold {$token} here
flagUnknown: a flag (`{$f}`) that is none of `i`, `m` and `s`
groupForm: a group form after `(?` that is none of `:`, a name, flags and `#`
groupName: a group name that is not a letter or `_` and then letters, digits and `_` up to its closing `>` or `'`
hexDigits: a code point escape (`\\{$e}`) with no digits of its form: `\\xHH`, `\\uHHHH`, `\\x\{H..\}`, `\\u\{H..\}` or `\\o\{O..\}`
nameTwice: a group name that names two groups
noCountTerm: a counted repetition (`\{m,n\}`) with no term before it
noTerm: a repeat (`*`, `+` or `?`) with no term before it
nulEscape: a NUL escape, which no `String` holds
octalEscape: an octal escape (`\\0` and a digit), which PCRE reads as a backreference: write `\\x` and two hex digits
patternBackslash: a backslash at the end of the pattern
pcreControl: a PCRE control form (`{$form}`), which only a backtracking engine has
posixName: a POSIX class (`[:..:]`) whose name is none of alnum, alpha, blank, cntrl, digit, graph, lower, print, punct, space, upper and xdigit
propertyClass: a Unicode property class (`{$form}\{..\}`) is not supported
setOperand: a class set operation (`&&`, `--` or `~~`) with no members on one side
strayBrace: a `\}` with no `\{` before it (a literal brace is `\\\}`)
tooDeep: a pattern that nests more than 250 levels deep
unknownEscape: the escape `\\{$c}` means nothing: a backslash makes only ASCII punctuation literal
